title: RecordTransitionPayload
description: Payload for `record transition` — the updated record and any non-fatal warnings (e.g., LIFECYCLE_FINAL_STATE). Envelope `diagnostics` is reserved for `ok: false` errors; non-fatal operational signals on a successful response belong in the typed payload per ADR-011. When the transition was fulfilled (RFC-022), `successor` / `relation` carry the artifacts.
